Overview

Holon is a city in Tel Aviv with a population of 196,000. A city in the Tel Aviv metropolitan area, known for its museums, industrial zones, and cultural institutions. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
